RQ2:How many translated texts have each L2 learner contributed to each condition (Original and GPT)?

```{r}
# Group by 'learner' and 'corpus', and count the number of occurrences
learner_corpus_counts <- LLM %>%
  group_by(learner, corpus) %>%
  summarise(data_count = n())

# View the result
print(learner_corpus_counts)
```
```{r}
text_counts <- LLM %>%
  group_by(corpus) %>%
  summarise(text_count = n_distinct(text))

text_counts
```
# Summarize the data to count the number of times each text was translated by different learners
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Summarize the data to check how many unique learners translated each text
text_learner_summary <- LLM %>%
  group_by(text) %>%
  summarise(unique_learners = n_distinct(learner), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(is_translated_by_multiple_learners = unique_learners > 1)

# Display the summary to check which texts have been translated by multiple learners
print(text_learner_summary)
```

######model fitting####
```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
```
```{r}

```

```{r}
View(LLM)
```

#the impact of corpus type on lexcial density
```{r}
summary(m.LD <- lmer(Lexical_density_tokens~
                       1+corpus+(1|learner)+(1|text),data=LLM))
```

```{r}
#model criticism
LLM_LD <- LLM %>%
  filter(abs(scale(resid(m.LD)))<=2.5)
```


```{r}
summary(m.LDfinal <- update(m.LD,.~.,data=LLM_LD))
```
```{r}
#examine the residuals
hist(resid(m.LDfinal))
```

```{r}
#compute R square
MuMIn::r.squaredGLMM(m.LDfinal)
```
                            
```{r}
#main effects
afex::mixed(Lexical_density_tokens ~ corpus +(1 | learner) ,data=LLM_LD,method="LRT")
```
```{r}
vif.mer <- function (fit) {
  ## adapted from rms::vif
  
  v <- vcov(fit)
  nam <- names(fixef(fit))
  
  ## exclude intercepts
  ns <- sum(1 * (nam == "Intercept" | nam == "(Intercept)"))
  if (ns > 0) {
    v <- v[-(1:ns), -(1:ns), drop = FALSE]
    nam <- nam[-(1:ns)]
  }
  
  d <- diag(v)^0.5
  v <- diag(solve(v/(d %o% d)))
  names(v) <- nam
  v
}

vif.mer(m.LDfinal)
```
```{r}
library(effects)
plot(allEffects(m.LDfinal))
```
https://rpubs.com/HaroldNelsonJr43/260932
```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(corrplot)

attach(LLM)
# Select columns from G to AC
selected_columns <- LLM %>%
  select(Lexical_density_tokens:C_S)

# Calculate the correlation matrix
cor_matrix <- cor(selected_columns, use = "complete.obs")  # "complete.obs" handles missing values

# Create the correlation plot
corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "circle", type = "upper", 
         tl.cex = 0.8, # Text label size
         tl.col = "black", # Text color
         diag = FALSE) # Hide the diagonal
```
